item.title: On Ethics
item.description: Reflections on Simon Blackburn's Ethics: A Very Short Introduction — on the foundations of Western and East Asian ethics, the Dao and Lady Wisdom, paternalism, and the role of time in moral judgment.

item.title: On Knowledge
item.description: Reflections on Jennifer Nagel's Knowledge: A Very Short Introduction — from the classical analysis of justified true belief to communal knowledge structures, the perspicuity of truth, and the unsolved problem of deceit.
